Maya: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — a few concrete Qs on partner pipeline + GTM asks. I'll list them and tag folks.

Leah: Thanks Maya — go for it.

Maya: 1) Status on the top 3 partner pilots we mentioned? who owns each, and what's the expected revenue/convert ETA (week-level if possible). We said 'Q2 pilots' but need firm weeks.

Leah: Top three: ClearStack — PoC week of Apr 8, terms signed, owner Alex. Expected ARR if converted: ~$28k/mo.

Alex: Confirmed. infra onboarding runbook in the partners repo. Pilot kickoff meeting Apr 10. Sales owner is Emily for conversion.

Emily: We'll own pilot success plan (adoption + SLA checks). Need a co-marketing one-pager from Partnerships by Apr 5 to include in outreach.

Maya: 2) For SDR sequences: what's the short messaging we should lean on for cost/latency differentiation vs big public APIs? A 1-liner + 2 bullets would be perfect.

TJ: Short 1-liner: "Redwood: predictable enterprise inference — latency SLOs, unit-cost controls, and flexible deploy models."

TJ: Two bullets for outreach: 1) Predictable latency SLAs and tail latency controls. 2) Cost controls via batching/caching + quantization recommendations.

Sophia: 3) Leadership asked about partner incentives — are we doing partner-enabled SKUs or rebates for co-sells? What budget exists?

Ben: Leadership note: we can approve up to 10% partner rebate on first-year committed ARR case-by-case. Finance signoff required (cc Juan).

Juan: Finance is comfortable with up to 10% pilot rebate if RevOps + Legal sign off the deal. Please submit the partner rebate request form (link posted in #vendors).

Maya: 4) Partnerships — can you share a collateral pack (one-pager, integration checklist, sample contract redlines) and canonical partner contact list so GTM teams don't spin up multiple versions?

Leah: I'll publish a partner pack by EOD Apr 2. It will include: 1-pager, integration checklist, sample SLA language, and suggested contract redlines. Contact list to follow after I sync with GTM.

Emily: Also asking for a short SDR training (15 min) on the new partner props — can we run that this week?

Leah: Yes — scheduling a 15-min drop-in: Fri 11am PT. Invite will go out today.

Kyle: Eng ask: for partner integrations we need a telemetry event schema so the Console can surface partner usage. Can Partnerships provide expected events and identifiers?

Alex: I'll drop an initial schema in the partners repo and ping this thread. ETA Apr 4.

Maya: Final: who owns the cross-functional handoff (RACI) between Partnerships, Sales, and Customer Success to avoid duplicate outreach during pilots?

Leah: RACI summary: Partnerships owns enablement & co-sell playbooks, Sales owns deal closure & renewals, CS owns post-close adoption and NPS. I'll post a visual RACI doc in the shared folder by Apr 3.

Emily: Noted — I'll add a calendar reminder to sync on handoffs and co-selling protocol.

Maya: Great. I'll capture these action items in the all-hands recap doc and follow up on any outstanding links. Ping me if you need escalation. :raised_hands:

Deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled for 2024-04-05 10:00:00 UTC to check partner pack publication and pilot kickoffs.
